_about: Testbed lanes on Ben's PC. Every lane is local only: UPnP off, no router forward, never reachable by players (Foundry EULA item 2, FAQ example 3). Live is the only instance players reach.
_ignoreSettings: World settings that change on their own while a world is open (a lease, the sky, applied weather, the healing clock, the last time a GM client was ready).
